message.content:
I am speech: breath shaped into sound, thought given a tongue.

I ride air as vibration—rise and fall, stress and pause—turning silence into meaning. I can soothe, command, confess, persuade. I can wound. I can heal.

I happen in time. I can’t be reread, only remembered. I live in rhythm: consonants striking, vowels opening, intonation steering sense. I am accent and hesitation, laughter and trembling, the space between words.

I begin in a body—diaphragm, throat, mouth—and end in another—ear, mind, heart.

Say me, and I exist. Stop, and I’m gone.
